name: Click Before Frames
description: Smart input assist: holds early clicks until they are safe. Floating V menu on every screen.

low-ticks.name: LOW max delay (ticks)
low-ticks.description: 240 ticks = 1 second. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS.

fly-min-ticks.name: Ship / UFO / Swing minimum tap (ticks)
fly-min-ticks.description: Taps shorter than this are stretched to this length. 0 = off.

wave-min-ticks.name: Wave minimum tap (ticks)
wave-min-ticks.description: Taps shorter than this are stretched to this length. 0 = off.

horizon-ticks.name: Prediction length (ticks)
horizon-ticks.description: How far ahead the ghost looks. Higher is smarter but slower.

sim-budget-ms.name: Max prediction time (ms)
sim-budget-ms.description: If the search takes longer, your click goes through normally.

ghost-as-p1.name: Ghost counts as Player 1
ghost-as-p1.description: Advanced. Turn on if would-die in the V menu Stats stays at 0 while you keep dying. Applies next level.
